items.source: ServerRequest and ServerResponse are immutable interfaces that offer JDK 8-friendly access to the HTTP request and response. Both request and response provide Reactive Streams back pressure against the body streams. The request body is represented with a Reactor Flux or Mono. The response body is represented with any Reactive Streams Publisher, including Flux and Mono. For more on that, see Reactive Libraries.
items.translation: ServerRequest 和 ServerResponse 是不可变接口，提供对 HTTP 请求和响应的 JDK 8 友好式访问。请求和响应均针对主体流提供 Reactive Streams 背压机制。请求主体由 Reactor Flux 或 Mono 表示。响应主体由任何 Reactive Streams Publisher 表示，包括 Flux 和 Mono。有关更多信息，请参阅 Reactive Libraries。

items.source: In WebFlux.fn, an HTTP request is handled with a HandlerFunction: a function that takes ServerRequest and returns a delayed ServerResponse (i.e. Mono<ServerResponse>). Both the request and the response object have immutable contracts that offer JDK 8-friendly access to the HTTP request and response. HandlerFunction is the equivalent of the body of a @RequestMapping method in the annotation-based programming model.
items.translation: 在 WebFlux.fn 中，HTTP 请求由 HandlerFunction 处理：这是一个接受 ServerRequest 并返回延迟的 ServerResponse（即 Mono<ServerResponse>）的函数。请求和响应对象都具有不可变契约，提供对 HTTP 请求和响应的 JDK 8 友好式访问。HandlerFunction 是注解编程模型中 @RequestMapping 方法主体的等价物。

items.source: Incoming requests are routed to a handler function with a RouterFunction: a function that takes ServerRequest and returns a delayed HandlerFunction (i.e. Mono<HandlerFunction>). When the router function matches, a handler function is returned; otherwise an empty Mono. RouterFunction is the equivalent of a @RequestMapping annotation, but with the major difference that router functions provide not just data, but also behavior.
items.translation: 传入的请求被路由到具有 RouterFunction 的处理函数：该函数接收 ServerRequest 并返回一个延迟的 HandlerFunction（即 Mono<HandlerFunction>）。当路由器函数匹配时，会返回一个处理函数；否则返回一个空的 Mono。RouterFunction 相当于 @RequestMapping 注解，但主要区别在于路由器函数不仅提供数据，还提供行为。

items.source: Many of the predicates from RequestPredicates are composed. For example, RequestPredicates.GET(String) is composed from RequestPredicates.method(HttpMethod) and RequestPredicates.path(String). The example shown above also uses two request predicates, as the builder uses RequestPredicates.GET internally, and composes that with the accept predicate.
items.translation: 许多 `RequestPredicates` 中的谓词是组合而成的。例如，`RequestPredicates.GET(String)` 是由 `RequestPredicates.method(HttpMethod)` 和 `RequestPredicates.path(String)` 组合而成。上面所示的例子也使用了两个请求谓词，因为构建器内部使用 `RequestPredicates.GET`，并将其与 `accept` 谓词组合。

The handler function parameter represents the next element in the chain. This is typically the handler that is routed to, but it can also be another filter if multiple are applied.

items.source: Router functions are used to route the requests to the corresponding HandlerFunction. Typically, you do not write router functions yourself, but rather use a method on the RouterFunctions utility class to create one. RouterFunctions.route() (no parameters) provides you with a fluent builder for creating a router function, whereas RouterFunctions.route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction) offers a direct way to create a router.
items.translation: 路由函数用于将请求路由到相应的HandlerFunction。通常，您不会自己编写路由函数，而是使用RouterFunctions工具类上的方法来创建路由函数。RouterFunctions.route()（无参数）为您提供一个用于创建路由函数的流式构建器，而RouterFunctions.route(RequestPredicate, HandlerFunction)则提供了一种直接创建路由器的方法。

items.source: Spring WebFlux includes WebFlux.fn, a lightweight functional programming model in which functions are used to route and handle requests and contracts are designed for immutability. It is an alternative to the annotation-based programming model but otherwise runs on the same Reactive Core foundation.

items.source:
Router functions are evaluated in order: if the first route does not match, the
second is evaluated, and so on.
Therefore, it makes sense to declare more specific routes before general ones.
This is also important when registering router functions as Spring beans, as will
be described later.
Note that this behavior is different from the annotation-based programming model, where the
"most specific" controller method is picked automatically.
items.translation: 路由函数按顺序进行评估：如果第一个路由不匹配，则评估第二个，依此类推。因此，在声明更具体的路由之前先声明通用路由是合理的。这在将路由函数注册为 Spring  bean 时也很重要，稍后将对此进行描述。请注意，此行为与基于注解的编程模型不同，后者会自动选择“最具体”的控制器方法。

items.source: 1 listPeople is a handler function that returns all Person objects found in the repository as JSON. 2 createPerson is a handler function that stores a new Person contained in the request body. Note that PersonRepository.savePerson(Person) returns Mono<Void>: an empty Mono that emits a completion signal when the person has been read from the request and stored. So we use the build(Publisher<Void>) method to send a response when that completion signal is received (that is, when the Person has been saved). 3 getPerson is a handler function that returns a single person, identified by the id path variable. We retrieve that Person from the repository and create a JSON response, if it is found. If it is not found, we use switchIfEmpty(Mono<T>) to return a 404 Not Found response.
items.translation: 1 listPeople 是一个处理器函数，返回仓库中找到的所有 Person 对象的 JSON 格式数据。 2 createPerson 是一个处理器函数，用于存储请求体中包含的新 Person。注意，PersonRepository.savePerson(Person) 返回的是 Mono<Void>：一个空的 Mono，当从请求中读取并存储该人员后，它会发出完成信号。因此，我们使用 build(Publisher<Void>) 方法在接收到该完成信号时（即 Person 已保存时）发送响应。 3 getPerson 是一个处理器函数，返回由 id 路径变量标识的单个人员。我们从仓库中检索该 Person 并创建 JSON 响应（如果找到）。如果未找到，我们使用 switchIfEmpty(Mono<T>) 返回 404 Not Found 响应。

items.source: 1 listPeople is a handler function that returns all Person objects found in the repository as JSON. 2 createPerson is a handler function that stores a new Person contained in the request body. Note that PersonRepository.savePerson(Person) is a suspending function with no return type. 3 getPerson is a handler function that returns a single person, identified by the id path variable. We retrieve that Person from the repository and create a JSON response, if it is found. If it is not found, we return a 404 Not Found response.
items.translation: 1 listPeople 是一个处理器函数，返回仓库中找到的所有 Person 对象的 JSON 格式数据。 2 createPerson 是一个处理器函数，用于存储请求体中包含的新 Person。注意，PersonRepository.savePerson(Person) 是一个无返回类型的挂起函数。 3 getPerson 是一个处理器函数，返回由 id 路径变量标识的单个人员。我们从仓库中检索该 Person 并创建 JSON 响应（如果找到）。如果未找到，则返回 404 Not Found 响应。
